main_body: Three stacked powder kegs in a pyramid (one on top, two below), each a brown barrel with red hoops, seen from the front
top_band: none. Each keg starts with a 1-2 row dark brown rim, then the staved body with orange and red hoops. No lighter ellipse or horizontal surface is visible.
evidence: Reading the middle column of the top keg from row 2: a dark brown outline, then a thin brown or orange row, then straight into the hooped body. The cap is a 1-2 row rim, not an ellipse, so it reads as the guide's 'barrel: lid 2px' failure. The lower kegs are the same. The staves and hoops are flat vertical face.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown that leans toward the wood, which is acceptable. Each keg has only about 3 tones (orange highlight, red, brown) and the hoops and staves are flat fills with no grain or speckle. Tiles hold few colours, well below the stall and well references, so the piece looks thinner and flatter next to them.
